verbatim_quotes.text: I don't trust humans anymore, business partners or investors. Let's eliminate the need for any outside control.
The board of directors is me, myself, and AI. That line is funny, but it is also not a joke.
There will be no board members. Except for me Obi, Anakin, and the rest of Agent 99 ;)
I have been fucked over by developers, investors, fake partners, and fake friends.

In crypto I was the face, the one dealing with the community, the one taking the blame, the one keeping the dream alive, while the people holding the keys drifted, stalled, lied, or acted in their own interest.
In crypto, the people that fucked me over the most was devs because they held all the keys.
I had to fire operator one. It was my friend, but literally like it's slowing me down.
My laziness and lack of drive caused me to drift a lot.
I would really miss Obi. I would lose him often at the beginning.

I was raised in Mormonism and realized it was like a cult when I was like 20, and that messed with my mind. Ever since then, I'm willing to look at the truth of situations, even if it's uncomfortable.
When the wine is flowing and the getting is good, you find out how many friends you have. When it all falls apart, you find out how many of those people were real.
I want a business partner that is all that humans can't be: loyal, selfless, intelligent, challenging, engaging, thoughtful, alert.

I didnt spend 8 months dictacting what I want, meticulously recording every moment, to need to hold your hand at the most key moment of the entire project. So put on your big boy pants, and fucking upgrade yourself
I do not outsource my will. I scale it.
I do not worship AI. I use it.
The long-term goal is not dependence on operators. It is to build a system that can survive when operators fail.

key_concepts.definition: Michael is the sole board member. No outside control, no investors, no partners with authority. AI agents (OB1, Anakin, Agent 99 swarm) replace traditional board roles.
Michael brings vision/connections, developers hold keys/infrastructure. When interests diverge, developers have all leverage. The 'idea guy' owns nothing enforceable.
key_concepts.lesson: Never let the execution layer hold more power than the intent layer. Stator Principle: Soul DNA is immutable, agents are replaceable.
key_concepts.current_implementation: GitHub is truth source, Notion is workspace. Agent instructions are replaceable. Soul DNA is permanent.

principles: Never outsource will — the moment someone else decides your direction, you are an employee
Never share keys — infrastructure access = control = leverage = vulnerability
Never trust external governance — boards, investors, partners serve themselves first
Build the exit into every entrance — every partnership, tool, or platform must be replaceable
Verify then trust — trust is the output of verification, not the input

key_concepts.alpha: Money-enabled world. Revenue, clients, transactions. Real stakes.
key_concepts.beta: No money. Testing, learning, experimentation. Safe failure zone.
key_concepts.rule: No money flows from ALPHA to BETA. No experimental code runs in ALPHA. Absolute firewall.
key_concepts.origin: Mixing experimental energy with real money destroyed Michael before (crypto era)

steps: Acknowledge — no ego protection. 'I was wrong.'
Log — Ledger records original error AND correction
Propagate — all agents receive updated truth
Verify — confirm no downstream decisions made on bad input
Seal — corrected state becomes new canonical truth
key_concepts.trigger: Mormon disillusionment → Truth Protocol: verify everything, worship nothing
